description:
Outcome: A member books eligible slots up to seven days ahead and holds at most two upcoming bookings, from owner setup answers.
Scope: Future/hour-aligned starts, valid courts, inclusive seven-day window and member-count checks inside T-005 shared serialized transaction; server-derived member identity. All externally reachable booking entry points enforce the complete policy. Excludes: separate concurrency infrastructure, cancellation and UI.
Acceptance: Past/out-of-window starts rejected; exact seven-day boundary allowed; third upcoming booking rejected; simultaneous requests for different slots by one member never exceed two; T-005 same-slot guarantees preserved.
Behaviour: Clear rule errors, full rollback on failure, safe retry without duplicate reservations, no leakage of another member identifying details.
Verification: Controlled-clock boundary tests, separate-connection member-limit races and regression tests for T-005 conflicts. Prerequisites: T-005. Assumptions: upcoming means starts_at strictly greater than now; booking start no later than now plus seven days; configurable timezone initially UTC and all 24 hourly starts initially.
title: Enforce booking window and member limits
